# ITM Customs

> Mesa, Arizona lighting shop. Sells rock lights (72, 84, 144 and 219-chip pure white, RGBW, 112-chip white and amber switchback), 17-inch wheel lights, mounts and merch online, and installs them, plus pod lights, light bars, chase lights, switch panels and 12V wiring, on trucks and side-by-sides at its Mesa shop. Drop-off and pickup Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 8 PM. Lifetime warranty on installs. 10% off for military, veterans, police, fire and EMS.

## Services
- [Rock Lights](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/rock-lights/): ITM Customs rock lights and underglow in pure white, RGBW color and switchback amber. Buy the kit or book an install in Mesa, plus what Arizona law allows.
- [Rock Lights For Trucks](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/rock-lights-for-trucks/): Rock lights for trucks, laid out light by light: wheel wells, sides, bumpers and grille, from 8 to 30 lights. Kits and installs from ITM Customs in Mesa.
- [Light Installation](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/light-installation/): Light installation in Mesa, AZ: rock, wheel, pod, chase and cab lights, light bars, underglow and switch panels. Our lights or yours, with a lifetime warranty.
- [Truck Lighting](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/truck-lighting/): Truck LED lighting from ITM Customs in Mesa, AZ: rock lights, wheel lights, cab and A-pillar lights, switchback amber and RGBW color, sold and installed.
- [Wheel Lights](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/wheel-lights/): 17-inch 5-row and 10-row pure white wheel ring lights from ITM Customs, plug and play with an app. $380 and $499. Installed at our Mesa, AZ shop.
- [Side-By-Side Lights](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/side-by-side-lights/): Rock lights for side-by-sides and UTVs: RZR, Can-Am, Talon and more. RGBW color, pure white and switchback kits, shipped or installed at our Mesa, AZ shop.
- [Exterior Lighting](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/exterior-lighting/): Pod lights, light bars, chase, whip, cab, mirror and fender lights and switch panels, installed on trucks at ITM Customs in Mesa, AZ. Covered for life.
- [Switch Panel Installation](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/switch-panel-installation/): Switch panel installs and 12V wiring on trucks and side-by-sides in Mesa, AZ. Every light on its own fused circuit, with a lifetime warranty on the install.
- [Switchback Rock Lights](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/switchback-rock-lights/): ITM's 112-chip switchback rock lights do white and amber from one light, with wigwag and strobe from the app. Sets of 4 at $200. Installed in Mesa.
- [Accessories](https://itmcustoms.com/pages/rock-light-accessories/): Magnetic rock light mounts that hold a light without drilling, plus the ITM tee and decal, from ITM Customs in Mesa, AZ.
